title: UN chief Guterres lauds Marcos for successful BARMM polls

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres on Monday lauded President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. for the “successful” conduct of the first elections in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) last September. Guterres made the remarks in his opening address at the 16th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)-UN Summit at the Philippine International Convention Center. “Your Excellency, President Marcos, allow me to start by strongly congratulating you for the successful conduct of elections in BARMM, fully consolidating a remarkable peace process,” Guterres said. “This should serve as an example well beyond the Philippines and this region,” he added.
